english: This is the first place his body was placed, twenty-seven years ago.
Fallen and exhumed. Like his city.
To see it in such a state... (Shake in anger.)
A relic of an old era. I should leave it be.
This is how every divine dominion ends.
With the cracking of an ugly tomb.
No need to cry over it.
Despite this, horrors still walk the grimy tiles.
Urth's traces still linger here. As it should.
